title: scheelea tetrasticha
intro: Scheelea tetrasticha, commonly known as the Amazonian tree, is a plant species native to the Amazon rainforest. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including its ability to lower fever and treat various infections. The therapeutic actions of Scheelea tetrasticha include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which help to soothe and protect the body from harm. The bioactive constituents of this plant include lignans, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
